caption: The drawing depicts a segment of architectural detailing, centered on the page with ample blank space surrounding it. The main object is a rectangular block, divided horizontally into two distinct sections. The top section features a square with a greenish-blue hue, inside of which is an ornate, scrolling botanical design in a darker shade of green. Four small floral motifs are visible near the bottom left of this square. Surrounding the square are reddish-brown blocks that extend vertically, exhibiting curved, concave lines and rounded forms, suggesting stone or brickwork. Below the square, the lower rectangular section displays diagonal stripes alternately colored in greenish-blue and brown, possibly representing a different material or decorative element. The rest of the composition is left as bare, off-white paper. Near the lower right of the architectural detail, the name "R. G. Miller" is written in neatly printed letters.
title: Painted Keystone
